title: FIREARMS INSTRUMENTING SYSTEM INTEGRATING DISTINCT MEASUREMENTS THAT INFLUENCES THE BALISTIC TRAJECTORY AND ITS CORRESPONDING DATA RETRIEVAL

measurement_fusion: multiple sensor inputs are collected by a microprocessor
sensor calibration is part of the measurement pipeline
environmental data can be requested from weather sources
local application software presents fused data in a single operator interface
software_split: embedded or resident firmware performs measurement and calibration functions
a separate application layer handles user interaction, external data access and storage
connectivity_and_storage: wired and wireless interfaces connect sensors and peripherals to the application
camera and environmental data can be integrated
records can be stored locally and in cloud storage
